node.title: Re^2: bullet proof SLURP file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
how about [doc://autodie]?

Unfortunately, it seems [doc://autodie] does not cover [doc://readline], although it does cover [doc://read]:

#!/usr/bin/env perl use warnings; use strict; use Data::Dump; package ReadFail { use parent 'Tie::Handle::Base'; sub READLINE { $! = 1; return } sub READ { $! = 1; return undef } } dd do { use autodie; open my $fh, '<', 'mydata.txt'; $fh = ReadFail->new($fh); local $/; <$fh>; }; eval { open my $fh, '<', 'mydata.txt' or die $!; $fh = ReadFail->new($fh); defined( my $data = do { local $/; <$fh> } ) or die $!; close $fh or die $!; dd $data; 1 } or warn "caught: $@"; eval { use autodie; open my $fh, '<:raw', 'mydata.txt'; my $size = -s $fh; $fh = ReadFail->new($fh); read($fh, my $data, $size); close $fh; dd $data; 1 } or warn "caught: $@"; __END__ () caught: Operation not permitted at rd2.pl line 23. caught: Can't read(GLOB(0x28a0888), , 18): Operation not permitted at rd2.pl line 33
